name: labs-firewall-dashboard
description: Teacher dashboard for managing lab firewall access via Mikrotik REST API

scripts.build: cd frontend && bun install && bun run build
scripts.build:all: bun install && bun run build && bun run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --composite false --incremental false -p frontend/tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p landing/tsconfig.json
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run backend/server.ts
